guideline: For each node in a graph, we assess both its content and dependency. Node content accuracy (or dependency accuracy) for a single graph is calculated as the proportion of nodes with correct content (or correct dependency). We also define node accuracy as the proportion of nodes that are correct in both content and dependency. These metrics are averaged across all graphs in the test set. A graph is considered fully correct if all its nodes are accurate in both content and dependency.
